title: Enterprise Feature Queue Qualifier Playbook
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Create a compact, repeatable playbook that Sales and Customer Success can use to aggregate enterprise feature requests, run a rapid qualification pass, and produce an initial scoping package for PM/Eng review. Aim: reduce noise in the product backlog, shorten time-to-first-scope, and surface clear signals for prioritization decisions.
background: Sales and CS currently forward a high volume of bespoke enterprise asks as emails, spreadsheets, and ad-hoc tickets. PMs spend disproportionate time clarifying scope, leading to long lead times and lost prioritization context. We need a low-friction, score-driven qualifier that lives at the Sales/CS touchpoint and produces a consistent artifact for downstream evaluation.
proposed_process: Step 0: Intake capture - Sales/CS use a single canonical form (Slack shortcut + lightweight web form) to log request with required fields.
Step 1: Triage badge - CS assigns a one-line category (Security, Compliance, Performance, Feature) and a customer priority level (1-5).
Step 2: Qualifier call - For asks with priority >=4 or ambiguous value, CS schedules a 30-min discovery with the customer and fills the discovery template.
Step 3: Scoring - Auto-calc a score using product strategic fit, revenue influence, technical effort range, and risk/sensitivity indicators.
Step 4: Consolidation - Weekly collector runs to group similar asks across accounts and produce a single consolidated brief.
Step 5: Handoff - Submit consolidated briefs to PM intake queue with tags and the autogenerated score; PM reviews during intake swimlane.
Step 6: Feedback loop - PM publishes decision (accept for scoping, deprioritize, or backlog) and CS communicates back to the customer within SLA.
triage_rubric: Strategic alignment (0-10): maps to roadmap initiatives or platform gaps.
Revenue impact (0-10): ARR influence or contract renewal risk.
Implementation effort (0-10): rough T-shirt estimate converted to points.
Security/Compliance sensitivity (0-10): regulatory blockers or data residency needs.
Customer concentration (0-10): number of customers requesting or market signal.
scoring_example: Example: A feature affecting E2E encryption with a single large customer renewal at risk -> Strategic 8, Revenue 9, Effort 6, Security 9, Concentration 3 => weighted score 8.0 -> flagged for PM scoping slot this cycle.
handoff_artifacts: One-pager brief (template): problem statement, customers affected, acceptance criteria, tentative success metrics.
Discovery notes: meeting notes with answers to 'why now' and 'workarounds'.
Technical hints: optional ENG pre-check comments if CS flagged potential infra impact.
Customer comms template: recommended language for update or ask for permission to share roadmap.
sla: Initial response to Sales/CS: 3 business days. Decision communicated to customer: 10 business days for qualified asks. Weekly consolidated review published every Monday.
metrics: Time-to-first-scope (days): target <= 14 after intake submission for qualifying asks.
Conversion rate to roadmap scoping: target 20% of qualified asks per quarter.
Backlog noise reduction: target 30% fewer raw one-off tickets routed to PM backlog.
CS satisfaction (NPS-like): target >= 8/10 on process ease.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot with three Sales/CS reps and 6 live customer asks completed using the form and templates.
Auto-scoring implemented in form and scores match manual scoring for 80% of pilot cases.
PM review meeting receives consolidated briefs for two different product areas and produces scoping decisions within SLA.
Positive qualitative feedback from Sales/CS stating the process reduced clarification back-and-forth.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales underfills form fields leading to poor scoring. Mitigation: make critical fields required and add validation + CS training session.
Risk: Overconsolidation hides unique customer nuances. Mitigation: include per-customer notes section and require at least one discovery note for grouped asks with score >=8.
Risk: PM triage capacity overloaded by consolidated briefs. Mitigation: cap weekly intake to top N by score and route remainder to backlog with transparent signals.
